permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Let's get you set up
permissions.body: Natively needs a few permissions to capture meetings and transcribe speech.
permissions.macScreenHint: Enable access in Privacy & Security settings.

startup.consent: By clicking Continue, you agree to our <0>Terms & Conditions</0> and <1>Privacy Policy</1>.

full.body: Allow Natively the following system accesses to enable premium recording, real-time assist tools, and seamless audio transcriptions.
full.assistDesc: Natively can prompt you to start taking notes when you join a meeting.
full.micDesc: Natively needs to capture your voice to transcribe your meetings in real-time.
full.screenLabel: Allow Natively to see your screen
full.screenDesc: Natively can answer questions about what you're viewing.
full.macPrompt: "Natively" would like to record this computer's screen and audio.
full.macPromptHint: Grant access to this application in Privacy & Security settings, located in System Settings.
full.systemPanelHint: Allow the applications below to record the content of your screen and audio, even while using other applications.
